scope: Current Engine Args and Quantization docs; configuration values are intentionally not presented as universal defaults.

claims.claim: max_model_len limits model context length and can be derived automatically from the model configuration when unspecified.
claims.notes: The chosen length still has to fit model capability and available memory.

claims.claim: gpu_memory_utilization is a per-instance device memory budget and its resolved default depends on extensible KV cache and platform support.
claims.notes: Do not copy one fixed value across releases or hardware.

claims.claim: max_num_seqs and max_num_batched_tokens constrain different dimensions: sequence capacity and per-iteration token budget.
claims.notes: Defaults and interaction with max_num_active_seqs can change.

claims.claim: Supported quantization formats and kernels depend on hardware and vLLM release.
claims.locator: Supported quantization formats and Supported Hardware
claims.notes: A loadable checkpoint does not guarantee the requested activation scheme or fastest kernel is selected.
